turns.speaker: facilitator
turns.text: What is the biggest operational problem you are trying to solve in the warehouse today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Our supervisors do not have a reliable real-time view of where orders are in the picking process. We usually find out about delays after a truck is already waiting.

turns.speaker: facilitator
turns.text: How quickly would the data need to update for it to be useful?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ideally within 30 seconds. Anything over a couple of minutes is probably too stale to act on.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We also need it to work on the rugged tablets the floor leads already carry, and we cannot replace the warehouse management system this year.

turns.speaker: facilitator
turns.text: Which functions have to remain available if connectivity is degraded?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It has to be live before our peak season, so we need go-live by the end of Q3, and it must keep working when the Wi-Fi drops in the yard.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Only shift supervisors should be able to reassign picks; floor staff just need to see status, not change it.
